name: Gold Tamuno
tagline: I build fast, reliable systems — from Go microservices to pixel-perfect UIs.
bio: Hey, I'm Gold — a software developer passionate about backend development with Go, scalable systems, and clean software architecture. I enjoy turning ideas into reliable applications and believe the best software is built with simplicity, curiosity, and attention to detail. When I'm not coding, I'm exploring new technologies or writing about my journey.
